title: Repeat-Violation Schedule Charge Worksheet: Community Rules & Site Care
content:
The repeat-violation charge under Community Rules & Site Care is assessed for the violation notice most recently served on the plan record; its rule class and violation sequence are read from that notice.

**Communities.** It is assessed only in a community permitting repeat charges, which are Saguaro Vista, Bluebonnet Ridge and Cedar Hollow, the community being the one named on the Home-Site Lease.

**Schedule charge.** The schedule charge is the plan's second-notice repeat charge for a notice whose violation sequence is two, and the plan's third-and-later repeat charge for a later one; a notice whose sequence is one carries no charge.

**The charge.** The repeat-violation charge is the schedule charge, rounded half up to the cent. A notice that carries no schedule charge — a notice whose sequence is one, or a notice in a community that does not permit repeat charges — carries no repeat-violation charge.

## Community and sequence

| Community named on the Home-Site Lease | Violation sequence of the notice | Schedule charge |
|---|---|---|
| Saguaro Vista, Bluebonnet Ridge or Cedar Hollow | 1 | none |
| Saguaro Vista, Bluebonnet Ridge or Cedar Hollow | 2 | the plan's second-notice repeat charge |
| Saguaro Vista, Bluebonnet Ridge or Cedar Hollow | 3 or more | the plan's third-and-later repeat charge |
| any other community | any | none |

## Worked example

Hypothetical plan figures of $45.00 for the second notice and $90.00 for later notices, chosen for illustration and not schedule values:

- Cedar Hollow, sequence 2: $45.00.
- Bluebonnet Ridge, sequence 4: $90.00.
- Willow Bend Estates, sequence 3: no repeat-violation charge.
